companies.icp: Any company: the tab sets no industry or segment restriction
qualifies: Any company that the signal is about

discovery.objective: Find companies that publicly announced opening a new office or facility in a new city on or after 2025-10-01. Any company, any size, any industry, anywhere: fit is decided later.

match_conditions.name: new_office_announced
match_conditions.description: A dated source (press release, news item, or the company's own announcement) shows this company opened, or announced it will open, an office or facility in a city where it did not previously have one, on or after 2025-10-01.

signals.research_brief: Confirm the new-office announcement is real and about this company: which city, when it was announced, and the source's own wording.

fields.name: new_office_city
fields.description: City of the newly opened or announced office, as written in the source.

fields.name: announcement_date
fields.description: Date the opening was announced, as precise as the source allows.

fields.name: announcement_wording
fields.description: The source's own sentence announcing the opening, quoted.

rules.description: A new office opening was announced by or about this company
Announced on or after 2025-10-01 (the window the tab gives)
